name: FFS_DBM_TASK_RUN
description: DB Maintenance: Used to store a state of the currently executed tasks as well as log records. This data is also used to resume long running tasks on restart of the service.

columns.name: TASK_RUN_ID
columns.description: Task run id. generated by sequence.

columns.name: TASK_LABEL
columns.description: Task name. List of supported tasks is in MS code.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Contains current status of the task run. Possible values: created, in_progress, completed, failed, in_rollback, rolledback, suspended.

columns.name: UPDATED_AT
columns.description: When task status/progress was updated.

columns.name: STARTED_AT
columns.description: Contains start time of the task run.

columns.name: FINISHED_AT
columns.description: Contains time when the task was completed.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Task run duration, w/o waits, sec.

columns.name: CHANGED_ROWS
columns.description: Contains number of changed rows by this task run.

columns.name: TERMINATED_AT
columns.description: When task received terminate signal.

columns.name: ROLLBACK_AT
columns.description: When rollback of the task was started.

columns.name: ROLLBACK_DURATION
columns.description: Task rollback run duration, sec.

columns.name: RUN_PARAM
columns.description: Task parameters, json: e.g cut_date.

columns.name: RUN_INFO
columns.description: Task run info, json: process/thread id, number of changed rows.

columns.name: VALIDATION_INFO
columns.description: Contains additional task run validation info. Optional, in json format.

columns.name: ERROR_INFO
columns.description: Error info, json: message/stack.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
